name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
description: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) is a large-scale multilingual audio corpus derived from LibriVox audiobooks, created by Facebook AI Research. It provides approximately 50,000 hours of 16kHz read speech across 8 European languages (English, German, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish), with about 44,000 hours in English and 6,000 hours across 7 other languages, providing a standard benchmark for multilingual ASR and speech representation learning.
